text:
Marisol: Quick kickoff  quarterly entitlement sweep. Idea: combine KMS grant/decrypt events + service-account last_used to auto-rank likely stale/high-risk admins for review. Keep it light so we can run this monthly after the pilot.
Alejandro: Sounds good. Do you have the log selectors sketched out?
Marisol: Yep, simple start: filter CreateGrant, UpdatePolicy, Decrypt in last 90d across prod projects. Example: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.methodName:("CreateGrant" OR "SetIamPolicy" OR "Decrypt")' --freshness=90d --format=json`
Priya: Two requirements: 1) only surface principals tied to privileged roles (roles/owner, roles/editor, roles/kms.admin) and 2) mask emails until the reviewer claim step.
Marisol: Will add a role filter and a redaction step that replaces emails with principal IDs and a hash for reviewer correlation.
Sam: CI/service principals are trickylong-lived tokens exist. We should mark those as "requires migration plan" rather than immediate removal.
Marisol: Agreed. Heuristic: non-human UA strings, tokens older than 60d, or no recent deploys => tag as CI. Those will get a mitigation checklist instead of removal.
Alejandro: Also add an availability column for audit history. Some sandboxes only have 30d of logs so we shouldn't penalize a principal if history is missing.
Priya: Ops-bot: can you accept a CSV and attach the rotation & attestation runbooks in the output? Also include a JIRA ticket template for reviewers.
ops-bot: Yes. Drop CSV to /tmp/entitlement-sweep with columns (principal_id, project, flagged_reason). I'll return a report with runbook links, a prefilled JIRA payload, and a short remediation timeline suggestion.
Marisol: Action items: 1) I'll build the query + redaction script and push to infra-reports by Wed EOD. 2) Alejandro: add audit-retention column. 3) Priya: confirm which roles count as "high-priv" and the redaction policy. 4) Sam: draft the CI mitigation checklist + common rotation commands.
Sam: I'll include sample `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete`/`keys create --key-file-type=json` flows and a fallback plan for CI breaks.
Priya: I'll drop the role list and redaction rules here once confirmed.
Marisol: If we can keep the manual review queue under 250 per run we're golden. I'll post the initial CSV and request 3 reviewers from platform/security next week. :thumbsup:
